title: Local constancy of higher direct images on real spectra under smoothness at real points
difficulty_reason: The paper explicitly calls the result a slight extension of Scheiderer Corollary 17.20(a); the latter applies when the proper map is globally smooth. Under smoothness only at real points, the authors reduce a real-spectrum specialization to a real closed valuation ring, establish its finite spectrum using finite transcendence degree, apply real étale proper base change, then use local smoothness, smooth base change and the Leray spectral sequence to prove the required cospecialization isomorphism. These specific steps are retained in the authors’ proof, and the cited earlier theorem is attributed rather than counted as their result.
